2.1.1.e: The 'पदविधि' given in the व्याकरणशास्त्र happens only for the words that exhibit सामर्थ्य (that is, those which are related to each other).

2.1.2.e: A सुबन्त that is followed by an आमन्त्रित will behave exactly like the अङ्ग of that आमन्त्रित,when it comes to determination of the स्वर in that सुबन्त.

2.1.3.e: The समास term is discussed from this sutra onwards till the end of second पाद of the second chapter.

2.1.4.e: A समास is formed when one सुबन्त combines with another related सुबन्त.

2.1.5.e: The समासाः told till 2.1.22 are called अव्ययीभावसमासाः ।
2.1.5.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.6.e: An अव्यय that is used in any of these meanings- विभक्तिः (e.g. 'अधि'), समीपम् (near, e.g. 'उप'), समृद्धिः (prosperity, e.g. 'सु') , व्यृद्धिः (deterioration, e.g. 'दुस्','दुर्'), अर्थाभावः (absence, e.g 'निर्'), अत्ययम् (expiry, e.g. 'अति'), असम्प्रतिः (non-presence, e.g. 'अति'), शब्दप्रादुर्भावः (appearance of the word, e.g. 'तत्'), पश्चात् (later, e.g. 'अनु'), यथा (eligibility, e.g. 'यथा'), आनुपूर्व्य (sequentially, e.g. 'अनु'), यौगपद्य (simultaneously, e.g. 'स'), सादृश्य (similarity, e.g. 'स'), सम्पत्ति (appropriate, e.g. 'स'), साकल्यार्थः (entirety, e.g. 'स'), अन्तवचनम् ('till', e.g. 'स') - undergoes a समास with a related सुबन्त, and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.
2.1.6.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.7.a: यथा असादृश्ये सुपा सह अव्ययीभावः समासः
2.1.7.e: The word 'यथा', when used in a meaning different than 'similarity', undergoes a समास with a related सुबन्त, and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.
2.1.7.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.8.a: यावत् अवधारणे सुपा सह अव्ययीभावः समासः
2.1.8.e: When the word 'यावत्' is used in the the meaning of अवधारणा (indication of a number, For example - 'as many'), it undergoes a समास with a related सुबन्त, and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.
2.1.8.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.9.a: सुप् मात्रार्थे प्रतिना सुपा सह समासः
2.1.9.e: The word 'प्रति' when used in the meaning of 'मात्रा' (little, a small amount) undergoes a समास with related सुबन्त, and the समास is called अव्ययीभाव.
2.1.9.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.10.a: अक्ष-शलाका-सङ्ख्याः परिणा सुपा सह अव्ययीभावः समासः
2.1.10.e: The word अक्ष (dice), the word शलाका (stick) and the words indicating a number - all undergo a समास with a related 'परि' शब्द, and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.
2.1.10.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.11.a: अप-परि-बहिः-अञ्चवः  पञ्चम्या  सुपा सह विभाषा अव्ययीभावसमासः
2.1.11.e: The words 'अप', 'परि', 'बहि' and the words generated from the verb 'अञ्च्' (E.g. प्राच्, प्रत्यच्, उदच् etc) optionally undergo a समास with related पञ्चम्यन्त word; and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.
2.1.11.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.12.a: मर्यादा-अभिविध्योः आङ् पञ्चम्याः विभाषा अव्ययीभावः समासः
2.1.12.e: The word 'आङ्' used in the meaning of मर्यादा (exclusive limit) and अभिविधि (inclusive limit) optionally undergoes a समास with a related word in पञ्चमी, and the समास is called अव्ययीभावसमास.
2.1.12.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.13.e: The words अभि and प्रति when implying direction (towards), are optionally compounded with a word ending in a case-affix denoting the limit, or the goal which regulates or marks the direction and the resulting compound is अव्ययीभाव।
2.1.13.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.14.e: The word अनु 'near to' is optionally compounded with that word, nearness to which is indicated by the particle and the resulting compound is अव्ययीभाव।
2.1.14.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.15.e: The word अनु 'alongside of' is optionally compounded with the word indicative of that whose length the particle expresses and compound so formed is called अव्ययीभाव।
2.1.15.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.16.e: And the words तिष्ठद्गु 'at the time when the cows stand to be milked', etc. are अव्ययीभाव compounds.
2.1.16.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.17.e: The words पार 'across' and मध्य 'middle' may optionally be compounded with a word ending in the 6th-Case-affix, when they take forms परे and मध्ये and the compound so formed is अव्ययीभाव।
2.1.17.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.18.e: A numeral (संख्या) may be compounded with a word denoting 'one belonging to a family' and the resulting compound is अव्ययीभाव ।
2.1.18.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.19.e: A numeral (संख्या) may be compounded with the names of 'rivers' and the resulting compound is अव्ययीभाव denoting an aggregate.
2.1.19.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.20.e: A word ending in a case-affix is compounded with words denoting the names of rivers, when the compound word denotes a thing other than that expressed by the terms of the compound and is an appellative, the compound so formed being an अव्ययीभाव ।
2.1.20.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · अव्ययीभावः

2.1.21.e: From this sūtra as far as sūtra [[2.2.23]], the word तत्-पुरुष is governing word, and is understood in all the following sūtras.
2.1.21.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.22.e: And the compound called द्विगु (Numeral Determinative Compound) is all called तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.22.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.23.e: A word ending in a 2nd case-affix is compounded with the words श्रित 'who had recourse to', अतीत 'gone by', पतित 'who has fallen upon', गत 'who has gone to', अत्यस्त 'who has passed', प्राप्त 'who has obtained' and अपान्न 'who has reached' and the resulting compound is called तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.23.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.24.e: The indeclinable word स्वयम् 'oneself' is compounded with a word ending in the affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.24.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.25.e: The word खट्वा in the Accusative -2nd case is compounded with a word ending in the affix क्त , when censure is implied and the compound so formed is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.25.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.26.e: The indeclinable word सामि 'half' is compounded with a word ending in the affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.26.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.27.e: The words denoting time, being in the Accusative -2nd case, are optionally compounded with a word ending in the affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.1.27.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.28.e: Words denoting time being in the Accusative -2nd case, are optionally compounded with a word ending in a case-affix, when used in the sense of complete connection throughout with the time (i.e. duration of time) and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.1.28.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.29.e: A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix is optionally compounded with what denotes quality, the quality being that which is instrumentally caused by the thing signified by what ends with the 3rd case-affix and with the word अर्थ 'wealth' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.29.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.30.e: A word ending in Instrumental -3rd case-affix is compounded with the words पूर्व 'prior', सदृश 'like', सम 'similar', अनर्थ 'words having the sense of less', कलह 'quarrel', निपुण 'proficient', मिश्र 'mixed' and श्लक्षण 'polished sleek', and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.30.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.31.e: A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix, when it denotes the agent or instrument -- [[2.3.18]], is compounded diversely with what ends with a कृत् affix and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.31.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.32.e: A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix when it denotes the agent or the Instrument, is compounded optionally with a word ending in a कृत्य affix, when exaggerated statement (whether of praise or of censure) is implied and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.32.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.33.e: A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix and denoting a condiment, is optionally compounded with a word ending in a case-affix, signifying food and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.33.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.34.e: A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix and denoting a relish giving or refining ingredient, is compounded with a word meaning, victuals and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.34.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.35.e: A word ending with the Dative -4th case is compounded with what denotes that which is for the purpose of what ends with the Dative -4th case and so too with the words अर्थ 'on account of', बलि 'a sacrifice', हित 'salutary', सुख 'pleasure' and रक्षित 'kept' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.35.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.36.e: A word ending with the Ablative -5th case-affix is optionally compounded with the word भय 'fear' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.36.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.37.e: A word ending with the Ablative -5th case-affix is compounded with the words अपेत 'gone away', अपोध 'carried away', मुक्त 'freed', पतित 'fallen', अपत्रस्त 'afraid of', when the event takes place in a gradual manner and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.37.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.38.e: Words with a sense of स्तोक 'a little', अन्तिक 'near', दूर 'far' and कृच्छ्र 'penance', ending in the Ablative -5th case are compounded with what ends in क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.38.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.39.e: A word ending in the Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with the words शौण्ड 'skilled' etc. and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.39.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.40.e: A word ending with the Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with the words सिद्ध 'perfected', शुष्क 'dried', पक्व 'cooked', and बन्ध 'bound' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.40.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.41.e: A word ending in the Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with the words ध्वाङ्क्ष 'a crow' and synonyms of crow when contempt is implied and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.41.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.42.e: A word ending with the Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with words ending with कृत्य-affix (a Future Passive Participle) and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.42.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.43.e: A word ending with the Locative -7th-case-affix is invariably compounded with a word ending in a case-affix, when the compound thus formed is used as an appellative and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.43.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.44.e: The names of divisions of day or night ending with Locative -7th-case-affix are compounded with words ending with affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.44.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.45.e: The word तत्र 'there' which is a word ending with Locative -7th-case-affix सप्तम्यास्त्रल् [[5.3.10]], is compounded with a word ending in क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.45.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.46.e: The word ending in Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with a word ending with the affix क्त when 'censure' is implied and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.46.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.47.e: The words like पात्रे-सम्मित 'a dish-companion' (a parasite) etc. are तत्-पुरुष compounds when contempt is implied.
2.1.47.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.48.e: A case-inflected word denoting an action which naturally precedes in time (पूर्वकाल) and the words एक 'one', सर्व 'all' जरत 'old', पुराण 'ancient', नव 'new', and केवल 'only' are compounded with their co-relative case-inflected words which are in the same case with them and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.48.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.49.e: The words expressing a point of the compass or a number (संख्या ) enter into composition with the word correlated to them by being in the same case, when the sense of the compound is that of an appellative and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.49.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.50.e: In a case where the sense is that of a तद्धित-affix or when an additional member comes after the compound or when an aggregate is to be expressed, then a word signifying a point of the compass or a number, enters into composition with a case-inflected word which is in agreement with it by being in the same case and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.50.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.51.e: In a case where the sense is that of a तद्धित-affix or when an additional member comes after the compound or when an aggregate is to be expressed, the compound, the first member of which is numeral, is called द्विगु (Numeral Determinative Compound).
2.1.51.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.52.e: Case-inflected words expressing vileness are compounded with case-inflected words, expressing contempt and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.52.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.53.e: The case-inflected words पाप 'sin' and अणक 'insignificant' are compounded with words expressive of vileness and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.53.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.54.e: Case-inflected words denoting objects of comparison are compounded with words denoting what is likened to them, by reason of the latter possessing qualities in common with the former and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.54.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.55.e: A case-inflected word denoting subject of comparison is compounded with the words व्याघ्र 'tiger' etc., the latter being the standard of comparison and in construction with the former and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ; provided that any word expressing the common characteristic (सामान्य) as explained above, is not used.
2.1.55.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.56.e: A case-inflected word denoting the qualifier (the Adjective), is compounded diversely with a case-inflected word denoting the thing thereby qualified, (the Substantive), the latter being in agreement (same case) with the former and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.56.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.57.e: A case-inflected words पूर्व 'prior', अपर 'other', प्रथम 'first', चरम 'last', जघन्य 'hindmost', समान 'equal', मध्य 'middle', मध्यम 'middle', and वीर 'hero' are compounded with words ending with a case-affix and which are in agreement (same case) with them and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.57.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.58.e: The case-inflected words श्रेणी 'class' etc. are compounded with words कृत् 'made' etc. which are in agreement (same case), with them and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.58.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.59.e: A word ending with the affix क्त and not having the negative augment नञ् is compounded with the same word ending with the affix क्त but which is distinguished from the former, by having the augment नञ् and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.59.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.60.e: The words सत् 'good, महत् 'great', परम 'highest', उत्तम 'best' and उत्कृष्ट 'excellent' are compounded with the words denoting the person deserving the respect and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.60.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.61.e: A case-inflected word denoting object deserving of respect is compounded with the words वृन्दारक 'eminent', नाग 'serpent or elephant', कुञ्जर 'elephant' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.61.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.62.e: The words कतर 'which or who of two', and कतम 'which or who of many', when used in asking questions about the genus or class, are compounded with the other case-inflected words with which they are in construction and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.62.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.63.e: The word किम् 'what', when implying 'contempt' is compounded with a word ending in case-affix and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.63.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.64.e: A case-inflected word denoting a genus (जाति) is compounded with the words पोटा 'a hermaphrodite', युवति 'a young female', स्तोक 'a little', कतिपय 'a few', गृष्टि 'a cow which has had only one calf', धेनु 'milch cow', वशा 'a barren female', वेहद् 'a cow that miscarries', बष्कयणी 'a cow that has a full-grown calf', प्रवक्तृ 'an expounder', श्रोत्रिय 'a learned ब्राह्मण ', अध्यापक 'a teacher' and धूर्त 'a cunning fellow' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.64.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.65.e: A case-inflected word denoting a genus (जाति) is compounded with a word denoting praise and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.65.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.66.e: The word युवा 'young' is compounded with the words खलति 'bald headed', पलित 'grey-haired', वलिन 'wrinkled', जरति 'decayed', when they are in agreement (same case) and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.66.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.67.e: Words ending with कृत् -affix and the word तुल्य 'equal' and its synonyms are compounded with words which do not denote genus (जाति) being in the same case with them and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.67.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.68.e: A case-inflected word denoting 'colour' is compounded with another case-inflected word which is in agreement with the former and also denotes colour and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.68.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.69.e: The word कुमार 'a boy' is compounded with co-ordinate words श्रमण 'an ascetic' etc. and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.69.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.1.70.e: A case-inflected word denoting a quadruped is compounded with the co-ordinate word गर्भिणी and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।
2.1.70.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.1.e: The words पूर्व 'front', अपर 'near', अधर 'lower', उत्तर 'upper', are compounded when in construction with a word signifying a thing that has parts, provided that the thing having parts is distinguished numerically by unity; and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.1.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.2.e: The word अर्द्ध when it signifies exactly equal parts i.e. halves, is always neuter and is compounded with a word signifying a thing that has parts, provided that the thing halved is numerically one; and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.2.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.3.e: The words द्वितीय 'second', तृतीय 'third', चतुर्थ 'fourth', तुर्य 'fourth', are optionally compounded with that word which signifies a thing that has parts, provided that the thing having parts is distinguished numerically by unity. The compound so formed is called तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.3.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.4.e: The words प्राप्त 'obtained', and आपन्न 'obtained' are optionally compounded with words ending in a Second Case-affix and form तत्-पुरुष compound.
2.2.4.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.5.e: Words denoting time are compounded when in construction, with words denoting the object whose duration is measured by the time, and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.5.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.6.e: The negative word नञ् is compounded with a case-inflected word with which it is in construction, and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.6.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.7.e: The word ईषत् 'a little' is compounded with a case-inflected word which does not end with a कृत् affix and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.7.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.8.e: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is compounded with a case-inflected word with which it is in construction and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.8.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.9.e: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is compounded with the word याजक 'sacrificer' etc. and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.9.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.10.e: A word in the genitive case is not compounded with another, when the force of the sixth case-affix is that of specification (निर्धारण).
2.2.10.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.11.e: A word ending in a sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word having the sense of an ordinal, an attribute, or satisfaction, or with a participle ending in the suffix सत् 3.2127, or an indeclinable, or ending with the affix तव्य , or with a word denoting the same object (i.e. when they are in apposition).
2.2.11.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.12.e: A word ending with sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with the affix क्त , when the force of क्त is to denote 'respect' etc.
2.2.12.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.13.e: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with the affix क्त , when the force of the latter is to denote 'locality' in which something happened
2.2.13.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.14.e: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is not compounded with another, when the force of the genitive is that of the accusative.
2.2.14.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.15.e: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with त्रिच् or अक , when the force of the genitive case is that of an agent.
2.2.15.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.16.e: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with त्रिच् or अक affix when the force of these latter affixes is that of an agent.
2.2.16.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.17.e: A word ending with a sixth case-affix is invariably compounded with a word ending with अक , when these affixes denote a sport or livelihood; and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.17.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.18.e: The indeclinable word कु 'bad' , the particles called गति and the prepositions प्र etc. are invariably compounded with other words with which they are in construction and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.18.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.19.e: An उपपद of attendant word तत्रोपपदं सप्तमीस्थम् [[3.1.92]] which does not end with a tense-affix [[3.4.78]] is invariably compounded with that with which it is in construction. The compound thus formed is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.19.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.20.e: When an उपपद is compounded with an indeclinable, then it is compounded only with those अव्ययs which end in the affix अम्।
2.2.20.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.21.e: An उपपद ending in third case-affix [[3.4.47]] etc. is compounded optionally with an indeclinable formed by the affix अम् and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.21.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.22.e: An उपपद ending in third case-affix or any other of the remaining four cases, is optionally compounded with a word ending with the affix क्तवा and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।
2.2.22.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा · तत्पुरुषः

2.2.23.e: The remaining compound is called बहुव्रीही।
2.2.23.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.24.e: Two or more words, ending in any case-affix, form compound, denoting another new thing, not connoted by those words individually and the compound is called बहुव्रीही।
2.2.24.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.25.e: indeclinable words and the words आसन्न 'near', अदूर 'near', अधिक 'more' and the words called संख्या (Numerals) are compounded with another संख्या word, when the sense is that of a numeral or संख्या। The compound is बहुव्रीही।
2.2.25.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.26.e: Words which are the names of the points of the compass are compounded, when the compound signifies the intermediate point and the compound so formed is बहुव्रीही।
2.2.26.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.27.e: Two homonymous words (both being in the locative case or both being in the instrumental case) are compounded, the sense being 'this happens therein or with that'. The compound so formed is बहुव्रीही।
2.2.27.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.28.e: The word सह 'together' is compounded with a word ending with the third case-affix and the compound is बहुव्रीही ; provided that, the companion and the person accompanied are equally effected by any action or thing, in the same manner.
2.2.28.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.29.e: When a set of several words ending with case-affixes stands in a relation expressable by 'and' the set is made into a compound and the compound so formed is called द्वन्द्व।
2.2.29.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.30.e: The उपसर्जन [[1.2.43]] is to be placed first in a compound.
2.2.30.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.31.e: The उपसर्जन is to be put last in the words राजदन्त etc.
2.2.31.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.32.e: In a द्वन्द्व compound, let a word called घि [[1.4.7]], stand first.
2.2.32.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.33.e: In a द्वन्द्व compound, let a what begins with a vowel and ends with a short अ be placed first.
2.2.33.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.34.e: In a द्वन्द्व compound, that word-form which has fewer vowels, is to be placed first.
2.2.34.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.35.e: A word with the seventh case-affix and an epithet are to be placed first in the बहुव्रीही compound.
2.2.35.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.36.e: What ends with a निष्ठा [[1.1.26]] shall stand first in a बहुव्रीही compound.
2.2.36.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.37.e: In the compounds अहिताग्नि and the like, the निष्ठा-formed word may optionally be placed first.
2.2.37.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.2.38.e: The words कडाराः and the like, are optionally placed first in the कर्मधार्य।
2.2.38.k: आकडारात् एका संज्ञा · प्राक्कडारात्समासः · सुप्सुपा · विभाषा

2.3.1.e: The word अनभिहिते meaning 'not being specified' is to be understood as the governing word.

2.3.2.e: When the object is not denoted by the termination of the verb i.e. when the verb does not agree with it, the 2nd case-affix is attached to the word.

2.3.3.e: In the छन्दस् (Veda), the object of the verb हु 'to sacrifice' takes the affix of the 3rd case and of the 2nd case as well.

2.3.4.e: A word joined with (or governed by) the word अन्तरा or अन्तरेण takes the second case-affix.

2.3.5.e: After a word denoting time, or length, the affix of the 2nd case is used, when denoting a full duration.

2.3.6.e: The 3rd case-affix is used after the words denoting the duration of time or place, when the accomplishment of the desired object is meant to be expressed.

2.3.7.e: A noun denoting time or place gets the affix of the 7th or the 5th case when the sense applied is that the time or space is the interval between one action and another (or implies an interval of time and space between कारक-s.

2.3.8.e: The 2nd case-affix is employed after a word which is joined with a कर्मप्रवचनीयाः [[1.4.83]].

2.3.9.e: Where a word is governed by a कर्मप्रवचनीयाः [[1.4.83]] in the sense of 'more than' उपोऽधिके च [[1.4.87]] or 'lord of' अधिरीश्वरे [[1.4.97]] there the 7th case-affix (locative) is used.

2.3.10.e: The 5th case-affix (Ablative) is used when a word is governed by the following कर्मप्रवचनीयाः [[1.4.83]] i.e. अप , आङ् and परि।

2.3.11.e: The 5th case-affix (Ablative) is used after whatsoever is governed by a कर्मप्रवचनीयाः [[1.4.83]] in the sense of 'substitute' or 'exchange' -- प्रतिः प्रतिनिधिप्रतिदानयोः [[1.4.92]].

2.3.12.e: In the case of roots implying motion, the place which the motion is directed takes the affix of the 2nd (Accusative) or the 4th (Dative) case in denoting the 'object', when physical motion is meant and the object is not a word expressing 'road'.

2.3.13.e: In denoting the सम्प्रदान-कारक -- कर्मणा यमभिप्रैति स सम्प्रदानम् [[1.4.32]], the 4th case-affix of the Dative is used after the noun.

2.3.14.e: The 4th case-affix is employed in denoting the object (कर्म) of that verb, which is suppressed (स्थानी) in a sentence and which has in construction (उपपद) there-with another verb, denoting an action, performed for the sake of the future action -- तुमुन्ण्वुलौ क्रियायां क्रियार्थायाम्[[3.3.10]]. In other words, when the sense of an infinitive of purpose formed by तुमुन् and ण्वुल् -- [[3.3.10]], is suppressed in a sentence, the object of this infinitive is put in the Dative -- 4th case.

2.3.15.e: The 4th case-affix is used after a crude-form which ends in an affix denoting 'condition' (abstract noun -- भाववचनाश्च [[3.3.11]]) and having the force of the affix तुम् (or Infinitive or purpose).

2.3.16.e: The 4th case-affix is used in conjunction with the words नमः 'salutation', स्वस्ति 'peace', स्वाहा , स्वधा (terms used in offering oblations to Gods and पित्रि-s, respectively), अलम् , 'a match for', 'sufficient for' and वषट् , a term for oblation.

2.3.17.e: In denoting the indirect object, which is not an animal, of the verb मन्य 'to think', the Dative -- 4th case is optionally used, when contempt is to be shown.

2.3.18.e: In denoting the agent -- स्वतन्त्रः कर्ता [[1.4.54]], or the instrument -- साधकतमं करणम् [[1.4.42]], the 3rd case is used.

2.3.19.e: When the word सह 'with', is joined to a word the latter takes the 3rd case, when the sense is that the word in the 3rd case is not the principal but the accompaniment of the principal thing.

2.3.20.e: By whatsoever limb, being defective, is pointed out the defect of the person after that the 3rd case-affix is used.

2.3.21.e: Any mark or attribute, by which is indicated the existence of a particular state or condition, is put in the 3rd case to express this relation.

2.3.22.e: After the verb सम्-ज्ञः , the 3rd case-affix is optionally used in denoting the object.

2.3.23.e: When the word denotes 'cause' it takes the 3rd case-affix.

2.3.24.e: A word implying 'debt', considered as a 'cause' but not as कर्तृ or agent, takes the 5th case-affix.

2.3.25.e: The 5th case-affix is used optionally when the noun expresses an attribute, being the cause of an action and not being of the feminine gender.

2.3.26.e: The 6th-Case-affix is used after a noun implying the cause of an action, when the word हेतु is used along with such a word.

2.3.27.e: After a सर्वनामस्थान -- सर्वादीनि सर्वनामानि [[1.1.27]], when it signifies the cause of an action and the word हेतु is used with it, the 3rd case-affix is used, as well as the 6th.

2.3.28.e: When the अपादान कारक -- ध्रुवमपायेऽपादानम् [[1.4.24]], is denoted, the 5th case-affix is used.

2.3.29.e: When a noun is joined with words meaning 'other than' or with आरात् 'near or remote', or इतर 'different from' or ऋते 'without', or words indicative of 'directions' (used also with reference to the time corresponding to them) or with words having अञ्चु 'to bend' as the last member of the compound and expressive of direction, or with words ending with the affix आच् -- दक्षिणादाच् [[5.3.36]] or आहि -- आहि च दूरे [[5.3.37]], the 5th case-affix is used.

2.3.30.e: The 6th-Case-affix is used when used in connection with words ending with affixes having the sense of the affix अतसुच -- दक्षिणोत्तराभ्यामतसुच् [[5.3.28]].

2.3.31.e: With a word ending with the affix एनाप् -- एनबन्यतरस्यामदूरेऽपञ्चम्याः [[5.3.35]], the 2nd case-affix is used, as well as the 6th.

2.3.32.e: When joined with the words पृथक् 'without', विना 'without' and नाना 'without', the 3rd case-affix is used, optionally (as well as the 5th and the 2nd).

2.3.33.e: When expressing an instrument-कारक, optionally after the words स्तोक 'little', अल्प 'little', कृच्छ्र 'difficulty' and कतिपय 'some', the 5th case-affix is used, when they do not denote material objects.

2.3.34.e: When in conjunction with words having the sense of दूर 'distant' and अन्तिक 'near', the 6th-Case-affix is optionally used.

2.3.35.e: After the words दूर 'distant' and अन्तिक 'near', the 2nd case-affix is used as well as the 5th and the 3rd.

2.3.36.e: The 7th case-affix is used when the sense is that of location -- आधारोऽधिकरणम् [[1.4.45]], as well as after the words meaning 'distant' and 'near'.

2.3.37.e: By the action (भाव) of whatsoever, the time of another action is indicated, that takes the 7th case-affix.

2.3.38.e: The 6th-Case-affix is used (as well as the 7th), when disregard is to be shown after that by whose action the time of another action is indicated.

2.3.39.e: The 6th and the 7th case-affixes are used after words when they are joined with स्वामिन् 'master', ईश्वर 'lord', अधिपति 'ruler', दायाद 'an heir', साक्षिन् 'witness', प्रतिभू 'a surety' and प्रसूत 'begotten'.

2.3.40.e: In conjunction with the words आयुक्त 'engaged', and कुशल 'skilful', when meaning entire absorption in an engagement, the 6th and the 7th case-affixes are used after a word.

2.3.41.e: The 6th and the 7th case-affixes are used after those words from which specification is made, (as of an individual from the whole class).

2.3.42.e: The 5th case-affix is used when the thing specified is different or divided from (and not included in) that from which specification is intended.

2.3.43.e: In conjunction with the words साधु 'good' and निपुण 'skilful' when they denote respect, the 7th case-affix is used, provided that the word प्रति is not used.

2.3.44.e: In conjunction with the words प्रसिक्त and उत्सुक 'greatly desirous of', the 3rd case-affix is used after the word, as well as the 7th.

2.3.45.e: When an affix declaring the time of an Asterism is elided by लुप् -- लुबविशेषे [[4.2.4]], the 7th and the 3rd case-affixes are used after the word, whose affix is also elided.

2.3.46.e: Where the sense is that of the Nominal-stem -- अर्थवदधातुरप्रत्ययः प्रातिपदिकम् [[1.2.45]], or of gender only, or measure only or number only, the 1st case-affix is used.

2.3.47.e: And when the sense is that of addressing, the 1st case-affix is used.

2.3.48.e: The word ending with the 1st case-affix, in the sense of addressing, is called आमन्त्रित or Vocative.

2.3.49.e: The प्रथमा-एकवचन when used in the context of  सम्बोधन gets the term  'सम्बुद्धि'.

2.3.50.e: The 6th-Case-affix is used in the remaining cases, that is to say, where there is a sense, such as the relation between property and its owner etc. different from that of a word related to a verb and from that of a Nominal-stem.

2.3.51.e: Of the verb ज्ञा , when not used in the sense 'to know', the instrument takes the 6th-Case-affix.

2.3.52.e: Of the verbs having the sense of 'remembering', (अधिक्), and of दय 'to give', 'to pity', 'to protect', 'to move' and of ईश 'to rule or be master of', the object takes the 6th-Case-affix.

2.3.53.e: The object of the verb कृ takes the 6th-Case-affix, when it means 'to impart a new quality or virtue' -- गन्धनावक्षेपणसेवनसाहसिक्यप्रतियत्नप्रकथनोपयोगेषु कृञः [[1.3.32]].

2.3.54.e: The object of verbs having the sense of रुज् 'to afflict', with the exception of the Causative verb ज्वरय 'to be feverish', takes the 6th-Case-affix, when the verb expresses a condition (i.e. when the subject is an Abstract noun).

2.3.55.e: Of the verb नाथ् when meaning 'to bless', the object takes the 6th-Case-affix.

2.3.56.e: The object of the verbs जासि 'to strike', 'to hurt', हन् 'to strike' preceded by नि and ग्र , नाट् 'to injure', क्राथ and पिष when they mean 'to injure', takes the 6th-Case-affix.

2.3.57.e: The object of the verbs व्यवहृ and पण् when they ae synonymous, that is when they mean 'dealing in sale and purchase transactions' or 'staking in gambling' takes the 6th-Case-affix.

2.3.58.e: The object of the verb दिव् when having the above-mentioned sense of 'dealing' or 'stalking', takes the 6th-Case.

2.3.59.e: The object of the verb दिव् when having the above-mentioned sense of 'dealing' or 'stalking', optionally takes the 6th-Case, when preceded by an उपसर्ग (preposition).

2.3.60.e: The object of the verb दिव् when having the above-mentioned sense of 'dealing' or 'stalking', takes the 2nd case, in the ब्राह्मण literature.

2.3.61.e: The object of the verb प्रेष्य and ब्रूहि (imperative singular of दिवादि verb, meaning 'send' and 'utter') denoting sacrificial food, takes the 6th-Case-affix, when making offerings to deity is meant or when deity is the recipient.

2.3.62.e: In the छन्दस् the 6th-Case-affix is used diversely with the force of the 4th case-affix.

2.3.63.e: The 6th-Case-affix is diversely used in the छन्दस् in denoting the instrument of the verb यज् 'to sacrifice'.

2.3.64.e: The 6th-Case-affix is used in denoting location (अधिकरण) after a word denoting time (काल) when used along with a word ending with an affix having the sense of कृत्वसुच् -- संख्यायाः क्रियाऽभ्यावृत्तिगणने कृत्वसुच् [[5.4.17]] 'so many times'.

2.3.65.e: The 6th-Case-affix is used after a word, in denoting the agent and the object, when used along with a word ending with a कृत्-affix --कृदतिङ् [[3.1.93]].

2.3.66.e: When the agent and the object of the action denoted by the words formed by कृत्-affixes, are both used in a sentence, in the object only, the 6th-Case-affix is employed and not in the agent (the object is put in the Genitive 6th-Case and not the Agent).

2.3.67.e: The past participle ending in क्त when used in the sense of the present tense, -- ञीतः क्तः [[3.2.187]] and -- मतिबुद्धिपूजार्थेभ्यश्च [[3.2.188]] , is used with the Genitive 6th-Case.

2.3.68.e: The past participle ending in क्त is used with the Genitive 6th-Case, when the former expresses location -- क्तोऽधिकरणे च ध्रौव्यगतिप्रत्यवसानार्थेभ्यः [[3.4.76]].

2.3.69.e: The 6th-Case-affix is not used the express the agent or the object, when the word is governed by an Active Participle ending in the affix ल , or उ , or उक or an indeclinable, or by a Past Participle in the क्त and क्तवतु or by a word ending in an affix having the sense of खल् or by a Noun of agency formed by तृन्।

2.3.70.e: The 6th-Case-affix is not used when the word is governed by a verbal noun in अक denoting futurity, or in a इन् denoting 'futurity and indebtedness'.

2.3.71.e: The 6th-Case-affix is optionally used in denoting the agent, (but not the object), when the word is governed by a Future Passive Participle (कृत्य).

2.3.72.e: The 3rd or the 6th-Case-affix may optionally be employed, when the word is joined with another word meaning 'like to or resemblance', excepting तुला and उपना।

2.3.73.e: The 4th as well as the 6th-Case-affix may be used, when blessing is intended in connection with the words आयुष 'long life', मद्र 'joy', भद्र 'good fortune', कुशल 'welfare', सुख 'happiness', अर्थ 'prosperity' and हित 'good'.

2.4.1.e: All affixes after the verb गाङ् 'to study' and the verb कुट् 'to be crooked' and the rest, are as if they had an indicatory ङ् (ङित्), except those affixes which have an indicatory ञ् (ञित्) or ण् (णित्).

2.4.2.e: An affix which begins with the augment इट् -- आर्धधातुकस्येड् वलादेः [[7.2.35]], is ङित् after the root विज् 'to fear, to move'.

2.4.3.e: A द्वन्द compound or words signifying persons belonging to the different Vedic-schools, when the sense is that of repetition is singular.

2.4.4.e: A द्वन्द compound of words denoting क्रतु (sacrifices) ordained by यजुर् (अध्वर्यु) Veda, is singular, provided they are never used in the neuter gender

2.4.5.e: A द्वन्द compound of words denoting (persons who have studied) subjects, which in their order of study are not remote from each other, is singular.

2.4.6.e: A द्वन्द compound of words signifying जाति (genus) which are not the names of living beings, is singular.

2.4.7.e: A द्वन्द compound of words of different genders, denoting names of rivers and countries, but not of towns, is singular.

2.4.8.e: A द्वन्द compound of words signifying small animals, is singular.

2.4.9.e: A द्वन्द compound of words signifying those animals only among whom there is permanent enmity i.e. natural and eternal antipathy or quarrel, is singular.

2.4.10.e: A द्वन्द compound of words denoting those classes of शुद्रा-s who have not been expelled from the communion of higher classes, is singular.

2.4.11.e: The word गवाश and others are also द्वन्द compounds which take the singular number.

2.4.12.e: A द्वन्द compound of words being the names of trees, wild animals, grass, corn, condiment, domestic beasts and birds and the compounds अश्व-वडव , पूर्व-पर and अधरोत्तर , are optionally singular.

2.4.13.e: A द्वन्द compound of words of contrary significations, but not being the names of concrete substances.

2.4.14.e: The द्वन्द compounds like दधिपय etc. are not singular.

2.4.15.e: A द्वन्द compound denoting a fixed number (एकत्व) of concrete things (अधिकरण) is not singular.

2.4.16.e: A द्वन्द compound denoting an approximate number of concrete substances, is optionally singular.

2.4.17.e: It, namely the द्विगु or द्वन्द compound, with regard to which singular number has been ordained by the above rules, is always neuter gender.

2.4.18.e: An अव्ययीभाव -- अव्ययं विभक्तिसमीपसमृद्धिव्यृद्ध्यर्थाभावात्ययासम्प्रतिशब्दप्रादुर्भावपश्चाद्यथाऽऽनुपूर्व्ययौगपद्यसादृश्यसम्पत्तिसाकल्यान्तवचनेषु [[2.1.6]], compound is also neuter gender.

2.4.19.e: A तत्-पुरुष compound, with the exception of that which is formed by the particle नञ् , and or the कर्मधारय compound, becomes neuter gender, in the cases explained in the following sūtras.

2.4.20.e: When denoting an appellative, a तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word कन्था 'town', is neuter in gender, provided that it is the name of a town situated in a country of the उशीनर-s.

2.4.21.e: A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the words उपज्ञा 'invention' and उपक्रम 'commencement' is neuter in gender, when it is intended to express the starting point of a work which is first invented or commenced.

2.4.22.e: A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word छाया 'shadow' in neuter in gender when the sense is that of profuseness of the thing indicated by the first term.

2.4.23.e: A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word सभा 'court' is neuter, provided that it is preceded by (a word synonymous with) the word राजा or by a word denoting a non-human-being.

2.4.24.e: A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word सभा 'court', when it does not mean a house but means concourse, is neuter.

2.4.25.e: A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the words सेना 'army', सुरा 'wine', छाया 'shadow', शाला 'house' and निशा 'night', is optionally neuter, with the exception of that which is formed by the particle नञ् -- नञ् [[2.2.6]], and the कर्मधारय compound.

2.4.26.e: The gender of द्वन्द compound or तत्-पुरुष compound is like that of the last word in it.

2.4.27.e: The gender of the compound of the word अश्व 'horse' and वडव 'a mare', is like that of the first word in it.

2.4.28.e: Of the compounds हेमन्त-शिशिरौ and अहोरात्रे , the gender is like that of the first word, in the छन्दस् ।

2.4.29.e: The द्वन्द and तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the words रात्र and अह्न are spoken of in masculine.

2.4.30.e: The तत्-पुरुष word अपथम् 'a bad road', is neuter.

2.4.31.e: The words अर्धर्च etc. are spoken of in masculine and neuter.

2.4.32.e: In the room of इदम् 'this', in the case of its re-employment in a subsequent member of the same sentence and referring to the same thing (अन्वादेश) there is the substitution of अश् which is अनुदात्त (gravely accented), when the Instrumental -3rd case-affix and the rest follow.

2.4.33.e: In the room of एतद् in the case of re-employment there is the substitution of the gravely accented अश् when the affixes त्र -- सप्तम्यास्त्रल् [[5.3.10]] and तस् -- पञ्चम्यास्तसिल् [[5.3.7]] follow, and the affixes त्र and तद् are अनुदात्त (gravely accented) also.

2.4.34.e: When an affix of the Accusative -2nd case or टा - Instrumental -3rd case singular or ओश् Locative -7th-case dual follows, एन् which is अनुदात्त is the substitute of इदम् and its re-employment.

2.4.35.e: The clause 'when the affix is आर्धधातुक is understood in the following sūtras up to sūtra [[2.4.58]].

2.4.36.e: The word जग्धि is the substitute of अद् 'to eat', when the affix ल्यप् -- समासेऽनञ्पूर्वे क्त्वो ल्यप् [[7.1.37]] or an आर्धधातुक कित् affix beginning with a त follows.

2.4.37.e: When लुङ् (Aorist) or सन् (Desiderative) follows घसॢ is the substitute of अद् 'to eat'.

2.4.38.e: And when the affix घञ् and अप् follow घसॢ is the substitute of अद्।

2.4.39.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), घसॢ is diversely substituted for अद्।

2.4.40.e: When लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows घसॢ is optionally the substitute of अद्।

2.4.41.e: When लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows, वयि is optionally the substitute follows of वेञ् 'to weave'.

2.4.42.e: बध् is the substitute of हन् 'to kill' when the आर्धधातुक लिङ् (Benedictive) follows.

2.4.43.e: And when लुङ् (Aorist) follows वध is the substitute of हन्।

2.4.44.e: When आत्मनेपद affixes follow, वध् is optionally the substitute of हन् in the लुङ् (Aorist).

2.4.45.e: गा is the substitute of the root इण् when लुङ् (Aorist) follows.

2.4.46.e: When the affix णि (causal follows, गामि is the substitute of इण् when the sense is not that of 'informing' but that of 'going'.

2.4.47.e: And when सन् (Desiderative) follows, गमि is the substitute of ण् when the sense is not that of 'informing'.

2.4.48.e: And of इङ् 'to study', गमि is the substitute when सन् follows.

2.4.49.e: गाम् is the substitute of इङ् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

2.4.50.e: गाङ् is optionally the substitute of इङ् when लुङ् (Aorist) and ऌङ् (Conditional Future) follow.

2.4.51.e: गाङ् is optionally the substitute of इङ् is the causative णि , when that causative takes the affix सन् (Desiderative) and चन् (Aorist).

2.4.52.e: भू is the substitute of the verb अस् 'to be' when an आर्धधातुक affix is to be applied.

2.4.53.e: वचि is the substitute of ब्रू 'to speak' when any आर्धधातुक affix is to be supplied.

2.4.54.e: ख्याञ् is the substitute of चक्षिङ् 'to perceive, to tell', when any आर्धधातुक affix is to be applied.

2.4.55.e: ख्याञ् is optionally the substitute of चक्षिङ् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

2.4.56.e: वी is the substitute of the verb अज् 'to drive', 'to lead', when an आर्धधातुक affix follows, with the exception of the affixes घञ् -- भावे [[3.3.18]] and अप् -- समुदोरजः पशुषु [[3.3.69]].

2.4.57.e: वी is optionally the substitute of अज् when the affix -- अनद्यतने लुट् [[3.3.15]] etc. follows.

2.4.58.e: After a word ending with the गोत्र affix ण्य -- कुर्वादिभ्यो ण्यः [[4.1.151]] and after a गोत्र word denoting the descendant of a क्षत्रिय or a ऋषि 'seer' and after a word ending with a गोत्र affix having an indicatory ञ् , the affix ञ् , the affix अण् and इञ् employed in the forming युवन् -- जीवति तु वंश्ये युवा [[4.1.163]], descendants, are elided by the substitution of लुक्।

2.4.59.e: And after the words पैल etc. there is the लुक् elision of the युवन् affix.

2.4.60.e: After a word ending in the गोत्र affix -- [[4.1.95]], there is elision of लुक् of the युवन् affix, when the गोत्र of the people called प्राच्य 'Eastern' is denoted.

2.4.61.e: After the words तौल्वलि and the rest, there is no लुक् elision of the युवन् affix.

2.4.62.e: There is लुक् elision of तद्राज -- ते तद्राजाः [[4.1.174]], affix, when the word is used in the plural number, provided that the plural number is taken by the base itself and not by its standing as a compound epithet dependent upon another word and provided that the base is not used in the feminine.

2.4.63.e: After the word यस्क etc. there is the लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix when the word of itself and not as part of a compound epithet dependent on another word, takes the plural; but not in the feminine.

2.4.64.e: And there is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix यञ् -- गर्गादिभ्यो यञ् [[4.1.105]] and अञ् -- अनृष्यानन्तर्ये बिदादिभ्योऽञ् [[4.1.104]], when the word of itself and not as part of a compound epithet dependent on another, takes the plural, but not in the feminine.

2.4.65.e: After the words अत्रि , भृगु , कुत्स , वशिष्ठ , गोतम , अङ्गिरस , there is elision of the गोत्र affix, when the word takes the plural, but not in the feminine.

2.4.66.e: And there is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix इञ् -- गोत्राद्यून्यस्त्रियाम् [[4.1.95]] after a word containing many vowels (a poly-syllabic word) which denotes the गोत्र of the people called प्राच्य and भरत when the word takes the plural.

2.4.67.e: After the words गोपवन etc. there is not लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix, when the word takes the plural.

2.4.68.e: After the words तिक , कितब etc. when used as द्वन्द compound, there is the लुक् elision of the गोत्र affixes when the compound word takes the plural.

2.4.69.e: After the words उपक etc. there is optionally लुक् elision of the गोत्र affix when the words take the plural whether they enter into द्वन्द compound or are used separately.

2.4.70.e: There is लुक् elision of the गोत्र affixes अण् and यञ् of the words अगस्त्य , and कौणडिन्य , when they take the plural and the words अगस्ति and कण्डिनच् are the substitutes of the bases so remaining after the elision.

2.4.71.e: A सुप् प्रत्यय that comes as a part of a धातु or a प्रातिपदिक is removed.

2.4.72.e: After the verb अद् 'to eat' and the rest there is लुक् elision of the विकरण शप् -- कर्तरि शप् [[3.1.68]].

2.4.73.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) there is diversely the लुक् elision of the विकरण शप् -- कर्तरि शप् [[3.1.68]].

2.4.74.e: And there is diversely the लुक् elision of यङ् -- धातोरेकाचो हलादेः क्रियासमभिहारे यङ् [[3.1.22]], when the affix अच् -- नन्दिग्रहिपचादिभ्यो ल्युणिन्यचः [[3.1.134]], follows.

2.4.75.e: After the verbs हू 'to sacrifice' and others there is श्लु elision of the विकरण शप् -- कर्तरि शप् [[3.1.68]].

2.4.76.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) there is elision of the शप् diversely.

2.4.77.e: For the verb roots गा, स्था, पा, भू and the verb roots referred as  'घु', the सिच्-विकरण is removed when followed by the  प्रत्यय of परस्मैपद.

2.4.78.e: For the verbs घ्रा, धेट्, शो, छो and सो, the सिच्-प्रत्यय is removed optionally when followed by a प्रत्यय of परस्मैपद.

2.4.79.e: After the verbs तन् 'to expand' and others there is optionally the लुक् elision of सिच् when the आत्मनेपद affixes त and थास् of the 2nd Person follow.

2.4.80.e: In the मन्त्र portion of the Vedas there is लुक् elision of the sign of the Aorist (& लिट् -Perfect Tense) after the verbs घस् 'to eat', हूर् 'to be crooked', णश् 'to destroy', वृ 'to choose, to cover', दह् 'to burn', verbs ending in long आ , वृच् 'to avoid', कृ 'to make', गमि 'to go' and जनि 'to be produced'.

2.4.81.e: The लकार that follows the 'आम्' प्रत्यय is removed.

2.4.82.e: The आप्-प्रत्ययाः and the सुप्-प्रत्ययाः attached to an अव्यय are removed by doing a लुक्.

2.4.83.e: There is not लुक् elision of the case-affix after an अव्ययीभाव compound that ends in आ ; आम् is the substitute of its case-affix es, but not when it is the 5th case-affix.

2.4.84.e: The change to अम् of the Instrumental -3rd case and Locative -7th-case-affixes coming after an अव्ययीभाव compound that ends in अ , occurs diversely.

2.4.85.e: The प्रथमपुरुष प्रत्ययाः of लुट्-लकार are converted respectively to डा, रौ and रस्.
